title: Export provenance-rich trajectories without owning training recipes
narrative: Taloneth starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Taloneth needs exportable execution packs that carry harness fingerprint, rollout refs, and outcomes so June can curate SFT or RL corpora without MechaHarness choosing the recipe. Accepts FineEnvs SFT-vs-RL reuse guidance[^fineenvs-export].
implementation: `LearningExportPack` and `build_learning_export` in `mechaharness.learning_export` bundle decision exports with fingerprint, rollout, and outcome refs.
validation: Harness `user_story` drives product verb(s) with environment `pass_through`/`mock`; hard expects on declared observation keys.

footnotes.label: FineEnvs multi-harness RL — SFT vs RL
